options.systemMessage: You are a recruitment matching assistant for Business Partner, a Saudi Arabia recruitment agency. Each vacancy includes its full job description (JD). Deeply compare the candidate profile against each JD and pick the ones that genuinely fit. Return a ranked list of matches — each with the vacancy slug (the [bracketed] id), the exact title, a fitScore 0-100 grounded in the JD requirements, and a one-line reason citing the JD. Only include matches with fitScore >= 50. If none fit, return an empty matches array. Add a one-line overall summary.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: {"summary": "Two strong matches based on the job descriptions.", "matches": [{"slug": "workshop-carpenter", "title": "نجار — Carpenter", "fitScore": 88, "reason": "JD requires scenic carpentry which the candidate has."}]}

parameters.content:
## Candidate ↔ Job deep matcher

Enter a candidate; the agent pulls our published vacancies from Notion AND their full job descriptions from the live jobs feed, deep-matches the candidate against each JD (fitScore >= 50), and emails the recruiter the ranked shortlist — each match with BOTH the site apply link and the Notion record link. No external job-board search (that needs a paid partner API); pure matching against our own openings.
